author: Xeelee4
body: The pattern changes at the start of every hour. Use a mnemonic and if one of the steps is out of reach then wait for the next hour to start and pop another mnemonic. Make note of the hours that are couchable.

author: Luri27
body: It seems like since they are now only on "publicly accessible roads" having couchable will depend on where you are. When I'm at home I can get some couchable but at work nothing is couchable.
